caption:
German pancakes are on repeat in our house! I love that it’s made with Canadian Dairy, which is produced with some of the highest standards in the world 👏🏻. Just look for the blue cow logo or “Product of Canada” on your dairy products to ensure you’re getting Canadian quality milk! @dairyfarmersofcanada @manitoba_dairy #thecanadianway #buycanadian #enjoydairy #ad

Recipe:
- 4 tbs butter 
- 1.5 cups of milk
- 1.5 cups of all purpose flour 
- 9 eggs
- splash of vanilla
- pinch of sea salt 

Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 425. Put the butter in a 9x13 baking dish and put in the oven until melted.
2. Blend the milk, eggs, flour, vanilla and salt. Pour the batter into the baking dish.
3) bake for 25 minutes or until big and fluffy
4) serve with lemon and icing sugar, or whatever toppings you want!

caption:
I feel like most of you know how to make sourdough, but for the few who don’t, here’s the recipe I’ve been using and loving!! Not one failed loaf yet. Comment “sourdough” for some starter kits with everything you’ll need. 

Step 1
Feed your starter the night before. I do 50g starter, 250g whole wheat flour, 250g water. Mix until combined and then cover and let sit on the counter overnight (it should double)

Step 2
The next morning add 250g whole wheat flour, 750g white flour, 20g sea salt and 750g of warm water to a bowl. Mix until combined. Let sit for 30 min 

Step 3
Add in 200g of the starter you fed the night before. Mix thoroughly and then cover and let sit for another 30 min 

Step 4
Do four stretch and folds (you can see me do this in the video), and then let rest for 30 min. Repeat this step 3-4 times.

Step 5
After the last stretch and fold, cover the dough and let it rise for 5-8 hours on the counter. It should double in size

Step 6
Dump out your dough onto the counter and split into two loaves. Use a bench scraper or your hands to create a ball and surface tension (watch my video for how I do this). Then let them rest for 20 min on the counter

Step 7
Get two bowls and put tea towels in the bottom, and dust with flour. Then dust the top of the dough with flour and flip upside down into the bowl/tea towel. Dust the bottom with flour and cover them up with the tea towel. Put these in the fridge overnight for 8-12 hours

Step 8
Take the dough out of the fridge and let sit for 1-2 hours. Preheat your oven to 500 degrees and put your Dutch ovens in to also heat up for 20 min. 

Step 9
Get a plate with parchment paper to flip the dough out of the bowl. Then grab the parchment paper and place into the hot Dutch oven and put the lid on. Score the top with a sharp blade (this allows the bread to rise). Bake both loaves at 450 for 25 min, then remove the lid and bake another 8-12 minutes (depending on how dark you want the crust)

That’s it!! Perfect sourdough every time. Let me know if you try it 🙌🏼

Soft White Bread Recipe
1 egg + 3/4 cup water (equal to 180g)
90g 2% milk
2.5tbs melted unsalted butter (33g)
1.75 tbs sugar (we used monk fruit)
1 tsp sea salt
416g bread flour
1.25 tsp instant dry yeast (3.8g)
